title: First-touch onramp deck: screenshot collage + sales-ready assets
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Produce a set of sales/solutions-ready deck visuals derived from the latest product screenshots for the upcoming Onramp release. These assets will be used by Sales and Solutions Engineering in customer-facing one-pagers and slide decks to illustrate the Redwood onboarding flow (sign-up, model selection, routing, rollouts, cost breakdown).

Scope: Capture curated screenshots from staging (redwood-staging.onramp) and assemble annotated collage compositions in the Design Figma file. Deliverables: 6 hero slide compositions (16:9), 3 compact mobile/thumbnail variants (4:3 and 1:1), and a sliceable export set (PNG/SVG) optimized for Google Slides and PowerPoint. All screenshots must have sensitive customer data redacted and include overlay callouts that map to sales talking points.

Out of scope: Full marketing hero photography, paid ad creative, and long-form product docs (separate PRD).
acceptance_criteria: Six 16:9 slide-ready compositions exported at 1920x1080 PNG with proper padding and safe zones
Three compact variants exported at 1200x900 and 1080x1080 for slide thumbnails and docs
All screenshots originate from the staging environment; API keys, org IDs, and example client tokens redacted
Each slide includes 1–2 short callouts (max 20 words) tied to sales talking points and a visual cue (arrow or highlight)
Signed off by PM (Marco Alvarez) and Sales Enablement lead (Jill Thompson) in the Figma comments thread
Assets uploaded to Drive folder + manifest sheet with filenames, dimensions, and alt text for accessibility
tasks: Capture screenshot master set from staging (Sophie) — spec: 2560x1440 desktop, dark and light mode variants
Run redaction pass to remove org-specific info (Design Ops) — use stage-redact script; save _redacted versions
Create 16:9 composite layouts in Figma: onboarding-flow, model-selection, routing-policy, rollout-canary, cost-breakdown, observability
Annotate each composition with sales callouts (copy provided by PM) and export slices
Produce mobile/thumbnail crops and an alt-text sheet for each image
Upload exports to Drive + add link to Sales enablement Notion page and update internal asset registry
